text: Teijin Limited is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (stock code 3401); its major-shareholder table as of March 31, 2026 shows The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account) as the largest shareholder with 15.37%, and no other holder above 7%.
short: Teijin is Tokyo-listed; largest holder is a trust account at 15.37%.

source.name: Teijin Limited: Stock Data (Stock Information)
source.quote: The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust account) 29,667,500 15.37
source.note: The same page states 'Stock Exchange Listings | Tokyo Stock Exchange (Prime Market)' and 'Stock Code | 3401', with the table 'As of March 31, 2026'. The other holders in the top-10 table are each below 7% (custody and trust accounts, Goldman Sachs International 6.88%, Nippon Life Insurance 3.65%, the employee stock ownership association 3.19%).
